interactions.title: Recap: Buruli, the jade, Gazankoa and the Sentient Ocean
lines: DM: So you had traveled through Sentient Ocean's little motivational quiz game, and as part of that learned that this merfolk city called Omi, where you are, was— had had the jade as part of their jade kelp garden, but this merfolk warlock Buruli had taken the jade and then launched a war in the name of a creature known as Gazankoa. As part of that war, had summoned a— opened a portal to the plane of water and invaded, and now mostly seems to control Omi plus whatever's on the other side of the portal.

DM: You saw, like, work crews moving around. There's, like, the city of Omi is encased by the Sentient Ocean, so nothing can leave, but the Sentient Ocean is not really an offensive force, and it is not— never launched an attack.

before: DM: So, I didn't have a chance to do session notes. But I'll do a very quick recap, so that you remember the context.
after: DM: There was, like, a giant, like, gash, like, rift running through part of the city.
DM: There was a really strong current flowing potentially into the rift which you defeated with control water.
DM: And there is some massive, tentacled creature guarding the portal to the plane of water which you discovered via the wand of Detect Magic that Seeker has, which also lets you detect portals.

DM: So where we left last time was Kenzo, Delwath and Wellby, invisible, by— potentially having alerted the giant creature to their presence because it heard some movement, and then walked around to all the entrances to this big courtyard where the portal was, and, like, pulled some kelp down, hanging in front of them, so it will see the kelp moving if anybody crosses—any invisible person crosses into the room. Hmm!

DM: At the same time Seeker and Riswynn have been hiding in the protective barrier of the Sentient Ocean the whole time, theoretically prepared to dimension door into combat when summoned, assuming Seeker actually follows through on such bravery.
